name: SL-004 precedence to a later namer
old: if x.prec = none ∧ x.bstat = .UNNAMED then { x with namers := ns, prec := lowest ns, bstat := .NAMED }
new: if x.bstat ≠ .BURNED then { x with namers := ns, prec := some eid, bstat := .NAMED }

name: SL-005 lapse burns nothing
old: | .lapse eid, x => if x.prec == some eid then burnC x else x

name: SL-010 end burns nothing
old: | .endReq eid, x => if x.prec == some eid then burnC x else x

name: SL-011 ECDSA burn by prec
old: | .endReq eid, x => if x.reserver == some eid then burnE x else x
new: | .endReq eid, x => if x.prec == some eid then burnE x else x

name: SL-007 unauthorized namer treated as in force
old: if s.inForce.contains (eid, x.root) then assignE s.inForce x1 else x1

name: SL-006 root of the authorization ignored
SL-008 reserver not set
old: { x with bstat := .RESERVED, reserver := some eid }

name: SL-009 claim from NAMED
old: | .claim eid, x => if x.prec == some eid && x.bstat == .RESERVED then
new: | .claim eid, x => if x.prec == some eid && x.bstat == .NAMED then

name: SL-020 other digest released
old: | .bound d' => if d' != d then [.slotBound] else opt (!x.current) .noRule

name: SL-021 any ticket signed
old: | .bound d' => if d' == d && x.current then

name: SL-014 window edge exclusive
old: else if h + B < l then .aboveWindow
new: else if h + B ≤ l then .aboveWindow

name: SL-013 pending below pending_min
old: else if pmin ≤ l ∧ pending.contains (l, eid) then .inWindow

name: SL-022 dealing restarts at 1
old: { suite := su, epoch := e, idx := top + i + 1,
new: { suite := su, epoch := e, idx := i + 1,

name: SL-005 a header that opens after the lapse takes a live precedence (revision 2, F4)
old: if names.contains x.key then burnIfLapsed lapsed (openSlot eid pos x) else x
new: if names.contains x.key then openSlot eid pos x else x

name: SL-005 late open burns only the opener's own lapse, read before the lapse list
old: | some e => if lapsed.contains e then burnC x else x
new: | some e => if lapsed.contains e && x.namers.length > 1 then burnC x else x

name: SL-016 SLOT_TAKEN at the open without the authorization in force (before DECISIONS 68)
old: if inForceAny s eid && s.opened.contains eid && takenFor s eid
new: if s.opened.contains eid && takenFor s eid

name: SL-016 no SLOT_TAKEN when the authorization comes into force after the open
old: | .inForce eid r => slotTakenAt (exec s (.inForce eid r)) eid
